subject: BSM - how to change number of iterations

messages.author: fb446a0e0cef2cfb
messages.subject: BSM - how to change number of iterations
parts:
Dear all,
I downloaded from the Phyloiwiki the code for BSM for time-stratified analysis.
By default, the script is set to 50 BSMs.
But I want to perform 1000 BSMs. When I changed 50 to 1000, the code stopped in that point and did not run.
How do I do?
Thanks

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] BSM - how to change number of iterations
parts:
I think you need to change this:

maxnum_maps_to_try=100, nummaps_goal=50, maxtries_per_branch=40000

...to e.g. this:

maxnum_maps_to_try=2000, nummaps_goal=1000, maxtries_per_branch=40000

That said, 100 stochastic maps is probably 99% as good as 1000.


Cheers,
Nick
